title: Actor spawning burst in single frame
fix_rationale: Burst actor spawns cause simultaneous component registration and construction script execution. Spreading spawns over multiple frames or object pooling resolves the hitch.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess frame time) executing actor spawning and initialization logic.

fixes.text: Implement an Actor Pool for frequently spawned entities (projectiles, effects, enemies).
Stagger multi-actor spawning across several frames using a spawn queue.
Simplify Blueprint Construction Scripts and move heavy logic to BeginPlay or C++.

verify: Re-test the gameplay trigger (e.g. enemy wave start) and check that SpawnActor frame time drops below budget.
